summary: Trade worked strongly for ~11 minutes, extending favorably from +27 up to a peak of +81pts with repeated new leg highs and low giveback -- clear thesis-intact holds throughout. At t=12m the trade violently reversed: local price collapsed from the +81 peak to +5.75 (92% giveback) over a sustained 3-minute adverse leg, not a single-bar wick, with KMDR, HA, and PROPP fire signals all flipping against simultaneously. That combination of magnitude, duration, and signal-stacking read as thesis failure rather than a normal dip, so I bailed. Next time I'd watch for giveback crossing roughly 50-60% of a leg's peak amplitude sustained over multiple minutes (vs the 10-30% noise seen earlier) as the earlier trigger, rather than waiting for it to approach 90%.
